title: One-color use
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose a monochrome signature when the surrounding image or color already supplies visual complexity. Contrast must hold across the whole mark.
strategic_value: Slack can retain the silhouette of its signature on photography and brand-colored surfaces where a multicolor treatment would be harder to apply.
demonstration: A two-column grid places monochrome signatures on a bridge photograph and five brand-color backgrounds. The yellow field uses a dark signature, while the others shown use white.
practical_value: When a production constraint calls for one-color artwork, compare the proposed surface with the six examples before choosing a black or white asset.
